items.title: GTA 6 multiplayer reportedly running on PC as unofficial ports near completion, but it's certainly no Grand Theft Auto Online
items.summary: PortWatch says TeK's group has a private unofficial PC build with players, cars and proximity voice chat running at 25 to 30 fps, and mods are also reportedly appearing.

items.title: December 11 is Suddenly an Exciting Day for GTA 6 Players
items.summary: Rockstar will release the GTA 6 Original Score by Justice on December 11, on CD, vinyl and streaming.

items.title: GTA 6 Cut Features Officially Revealed by Rockstar
items.summary: Rockstar developers told PCGames.de that tennis, prone, house furnishing, item crafting and cinema visits were cut from the final game.

items.title: GTA 6 Softlock Bug Keeps You From Finishing the Main Story
items.summary: Some players get stuck at roughly 72% story completion when Raul never calls Lucia in the mission Raul's Plan, and the article describes a workaround that involves Valentina's call.

items.title: Union Vote Fails In Landslide At GTA 6 Studio Rockstar Games As 75 Percent Of Devs Vote No
items.summary: UK Rockstar developers voted about 75% against a union recognition deal with the IWGB, and Rockstar's head of publishing said the result reflects staff support for direct collaboration.

items.title: GTA 6 appears to be running on Windows PCs, but malware, takedowns, and legal risks make it a dangerous temptation
items.summary: Unofficial recompilation builds are now reportedly running GTA 6 on PC at 60+ FPS, but Take-Two takedowns and malware risks surround them.

items.title: GTA 6: All Secret Radio Stations and how to unlock them
items.summary: A guide to unlocking The Vault and Kodak Black's The Sniper of LaPerle radio stations by scanning posters around Vice City.

items.title: Popular GTA 6 PC project "is not dead," 15-year-old lead clarifies
items.summary: The teenage lead of the Leonida unofficial PC port project says it is back after the Discord takedown and will show new progress in the coming days.

items.title: GTA 6 players fix the weather system themselves after Rockstar's latest patch left them hanging
items.summary: Players say clearing the PS5 system cache fixes the stuck-weather bug that the first patch didn't fix for them, and they report storms appearing straight away.

items.title: GTA 6 Secret Mission in Capri: How to Find and Complete the Hidden Mission
items.summary: A walkthrough of a hidden Capri mission that starts when you get arrested and ends with you escaping a police holding facility and getting the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun.
